 899:             bidx0, bidx1, bidx2,

 906: @cython.boundscheck(False)
 907: @cython.wraparound(False)

 909: cdef void _asm_core_vec_3d_kernel(
 910:     BaseVectorAssembler3D asm,
 911:     bint symmetric,
 912:     unsigned[:, ::1] bidx0, unsigned[:, ::1] bidx1, unsigned[:, ::1] bidx2,
 913:     size_t[::1] transp0, size_t[::1] transp1, size_t[::1] transp2,

 924:     MU0, MU1, MU2 = bidx0.shape[0], bidx1.shape[0], bidx2.shape[0]
 925: 
 926:     i[0] = bidx0[mu0, 0]
 927:     j[0] = bidx0[mu0, 1]
 928:

 930:         diag0 = <int>j[0] - <int>i[0]
 931:         if diag0 > 0:       # block is above diagonal?
 932:             return
 933: 
 934:     for mu1 in range(MU1):
 935:         i[1] = bidx1[mu1, 0]
 936:         j[1] = bidx1[mu1, 1]
 937: 
 938:         if symmetric:
 939:             diag1 = <int>j[1] - <int>i[1]
 940:             if diag0 == 0 and diag1 > 0:
 941:                 continue
 942:

 945:             j[2] = bidx2[mu2, 1]
 946:

 949:                 if diag0 == 0 and diag1 == 0 and diag2 > 0:
 950:                     continue
 951: 
 952:             asm.entry_impl(i, j, &entries[ mu0, mu1, mu2, 0 ])
 953:

 956:                     for row in range(numcomp[1]):
 957:                         for col in range(numcomp[0]):
 958:                             entries[transp0[mu0], transp1[mu1], transp2[mu2], col*numcomp[0] + row] = entries[mu0, mu1, mu2, row*numcomp[0] + col]
